richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mehsana

c: Mehsana in north Gujarat is dairy country, and the town is also known for its oil and gas fields. Most outdoor gym enquiries from here come from schools, colleges, housing societies and dairy or industrial campuses with staff colonies. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mehsana. We build every machine at our factory in Vasai, about 470 km away, and send it north by road.

Mehsana's climate is dry for most of the year. Summers are very hot, the monsoon is short, and winter evenings turn pleasant enough for long walks. A hard, dry base suits an outdoor gym, so you do not need a lawn. We suggest paver blocks or concrete under the machines and a few shade trees on the western side. Our installation team or a dealer in western India fixes the set on site.

items.q: Do we need grass under outdoor gym machines in Mehsana?
items.a: No. A paver or concrete base works well in dry areas and needs no watering. Rubber flooring can be laid where people step on and off the machines.

items.q: Can a dairy or company campus order a set for its staff colony?
items.a: Yes. Share the area, the number of families and photos. We will suggest machines, prepare a layout with clear space marked and send a quote for approval.

items.q: How do I reach FunPlay's sales team?
items.a: Call +91 902 830 2266 or write to sales@funplaysystems.com. The team works Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM, and replies with a suggested list and a quote.
